name: JK Soushitsu Replay ~Shojo Soushitsu o Nando mo Ajiwaeru Otoko~
original_name: JK喪失リプレイ ～処女喪失を何度も味わえる男～
source:
Haruka is hit by a car, sent flying through the air right in front of me.  
As I watch the scene before me, I realize something.  
I think of the secrets Haruka had been hiding, and what I should have done for her.  

It’s my fault.  
I killed Haruka.  
I was the one slowly melting her icy heart.  
I was her first man.  
But something was missing.  
I was lacking something—something as a man—and it led to Haruka’s death.  
I deeply regret her death and reflect on my mistakes.  
I want to do it all over again.  

When I wake up, there’s Haruka, alive and well.  
Thank goodness.  
Really, thank goodness.  
I’ll never let Haruka die again.  

I’m the only one who gets to take Haruka’s virginity.  
I’m the only one who can make her happy. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008809.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
遥香在我眼前被车撞飞。
我注视着眼前这一幕，意识到了一件事。
我想起了遥香一直隐藏的秘密，也想起了自己本该为她做些什么。

都是我的错。
是我杀了遥香。
是我一点一点融化了她冰冷的心。
我是她的第一个男人。
但还缺少某样东西。
我作为男人还欠缺某样东西，而这导致了遥香的死亡。
我为她的死深深悔恨，反省自己的错误。
我想把一切重新来过。

醒来时，遥香还活着，而且安然无恙。
谢天谢地。
真的，谢天谢地。
我绝不会再让遥香死去。

只有我能夺走遥香的处女。
只有我能让她幸福。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008809.html/]DLsite[/url]]
